title: CLI Options
description: Everything about options
---

Options are flags like `--name`.

# Tutorial

## CLI **Options**

Options are optional by default.

### Required Options

To make an option required, give it no default value:

```python
# This is a comment, not a heading
def main(name: str = typer.Option()):
    print(name)
```

## Advanced
### Callbacks

Run code when an option is parsed.
